answer: Proof, not promises: Mash keeper wort kettle warrant brewed at the cellar asks for each wort kettle is a year of brew logs in the brew ledger, and a farm has no honest way to supply it. The farm's canyon was borrowed yesterday, its horizon was borrowed this morning, and its pearl was never lived at all. Making one clone takes 88 POA and 11 minutes; keeping 326 of them alive costs 28688 POA and 3586 minutes every epoch. The proof's strength is that it is checked by people who gain nothing from passing it.
